description: Open and retain one loopback socket for every configured service address.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary service connection management software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs service connection management only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. Network calls lack resource limits; network targets are loopback placeholders. Policy basis: This capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
